Almost no one knows that the current Alpha Scorchhowl of Beast Fang Ridge was born in the same era as the Icho. But beside the Icho’s brilliance as a prodigy, his light seemed faint. By the time the Icho had already claimed his name, he was still just an Emberpup, training day after day, staring up at the blooming Thousand-Fang Ridge. His growth was slow—so slow it went unnoticed, even dismissed as ordinary. Many Flameruffs and Emberpups pitied him, saying it was unfortunate to be born in the same age as the Icho. Yet while others sighed, he kept moving forward at his own pace. Step by step, year after year, he eventually reached the same height the Icho had once attained.
